annotations.title: Set where the Google connection returns to

description: Save on an app the page the browser returns to after a Google Calendar connection started for that app (google_calendar_connect with appId, or the site's own "connect" button through POST /integrations/oauth/google_calendar/initiate with appId). Only a path, e.g. "/#admin": the domain is always the app's own at the moment of connecting, so a later domain change needs nothing here. Stored as settings.googleCalendar.returnPath. null removes it (back to "/").

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

returnPath.description: A path starting with "/", e.g. "/#admin". null removes it

name: google_calendar_set_return_path
